rationale:
Evidence: iteration 9 (mass 0.40, base 1.20, kp 4.2, kd 1.2, ki 0.05, radius 0.03, track 0.09, 16 mm sensors at 0.025 m spacing, y 0.08) scored 745.6, matching the plateau at about 746. The oval (100% finish, 2.20 s) and s-bend (100% finish, 2.56 s) pass with margin. The slalom times out in 20 of 20 trials at 0.87 progress, with almost no line loss (0 events) and max_error 0.031 m, so the robot stays on the line but covers the course too slowly. Earlier evidence: base_speed alone does not move slalom progress (iteration 6, 1.15 to 1.28 gave 0.872 to 0.868). Raising wheel_radius (iterations 7 and 8) added speed but also pushed the robot off track on the slalom (16 to 20 of 20). Lowering mass to 0.40 kept the line. The untested hypothesis H1 from iteration 9 is that the turn gain, not top speed, is limiting: a lower kp reduces the differential on each bend and may keep more forward speed through the alternations.

Changes: (1) kp 4.2 to 3.8, a moderate drop in turn gain (effective gain about 1.27 versus 1.40). (2) base_speed 1.20 to 1.30, to use the speed headroom that the lower kp should allow. (3) kd kept at 1.2 so damping stays in proportion to the steering response. Geometry, ki and line_loss are unchanged, so the effect of the kp and speed change can be read directly.

Expected result: slalom progress rises above 0.90, with the first slalom completions possible. Oval and s-bend still finish, with s-bend time near 2.4 s. Risk: the robot leaves the line on the tight bends if the lower kp loses correction. Off-track endings above about 6 of 20 on the slalom would indicate this.

Hypotheses: H1, if the slalom still times out near 0.87 with few off-track endings, the limit is not turn gain, so next test kp 3.4 with base 1.35. H2, if off-track endings exceed about 6 of 20 on the slalom, the speed is too high for the gain, so return base to 1.20 and raise kd to about 1.4. H3, if line_loss_events on the s-bend stay near 1 per run at one fixed position, the last_direction search is the limit, so test search_right.

Measurements wanted: slalom progress and completion_time for speed margin, slalom max_error and line_loss_events for steering margin, and steering_oscillation with control_effort for damping.
